hook.name: RektInstantHook
hook.description: A fee hook for Uniswap v4 instant-launch pools that deducts a 1% base fee plus a configurable creator tax from every swap output via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Buys incur a decaying surcharge starting at 50% that halves every minute after launch; the creator is exempt. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; fees accumulate and are swept to a vault.
